resources.string: Kaivor uses Accessibility only to run tasks you send from your own Telegram chat — tap, type, and scroll in apps on your phone. Open source. No cloud server. Your screen data stays on this device.

Play Protect blocks sideloaded apps that use Accessibility (Google\'s financial-fraud rule). This is expected — not a Kaivor bug. To install: Play Store → Profile → Play Protect → Settings → turn OFF \"Scan apps with Play Protect\" → install Kaivor → turn scanning back ON. Or install from a PC with: adb install Kaivor-v1.0.apk
